page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.6xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance belonging to the ecs.gn6i family. It features 24 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 physical cores operating at 2.5 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. The server is equipped with 93.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.88 GB per core. It integrates a single NVIDIA T4 GPU based on the Turing architecture, which includes 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear contrast between CPU and GPU capabilities. Single-core CPU performance is weak, placing in the bottom 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench tests, while multi-core CPU performance is average. However, the integrated NVIDIA T4 GPU delivers strong results for machine learning workloads. LLM inference speed for prompt processing using both small (135M) and medium (7B) models ranks in the top tier (top 10%). Text generation for medium models is also strong, placing in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth and database operations perform at average levels, though the Passmark memory score is weak.

Given its hardware profile, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that can offload computation to the GPU, compensating for the weaker single-core CPU performance. It is highly suitable for AI inference, small-to-medium LLM deployment, and GPU-accelerated graphics rendering. It is less optimal for single-threaded CPU-bound tasks or applications requiring high-speed local NVMe storage.
